assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known atrial fibrillation and a personal history of transient ischemic attacks.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic episodes with arrhythmic events and to optimize rate control and anticoagulation management.
The patient has a diagnosis of atrial fibrillation (I48.91).
The patient has a diagnosis of transient ischemic attack (G45.9).
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks (Z86.73).
Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded with CPT 93229.
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the symptomatic palpitations and lightheadedness associated with the atrial fibrillation and prior transient ischemic attacks.
